notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives only a header and the word Removed. Wikipedia describes the former community, not a tower, so the story gives no build, height, staffing or fire facts. Agency conflict: the header says Mark Twain National Forest, but the community sits inside Fort Leonard Wood, and no source read ties that fort to the national forest. The agency is kept from the brief and is unconfirmed. The 2015 MDC plan (Phelps and Pulaski County Towersites Area Management Plan, missouriconservation.com PDF) lists a fire tower built in 1955, 90 ft tall, at a Fort Leonard Wood towersite. That plan does not name Bloodland, so it is left out of the story and is a likely source of confusion. Access is not recorded.
